name: approvals_list
description: Lists the requests this workspace's tools left for the user to approve: which are still waiting, which the user approved (with what the action returned, such as a new ticket's key) or dismissed, and which failed. Use it when the user asks whether something went through, or before telling them the result of a request they approved. It approves nothing; only the user's click in the chat does. Returns one line per request, newest first.
